text: The following question stood in the name of  Mr Sharael Taha –   7 To ask the Minister for National Development (a) what percentage of divorced couples are able to afford their own HDB flats individually after the sale of their matrimonial HDB flats; (b) whether the Ministry has a further breakdown of this data by age group and gender; and (c) for divorcees who are unable to afford their own HDB flats individually, whether the Ministry has a breakdown of the data of lodging solutions for these individuals.

speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development )
text: Divorcees who are unable to afford an HDB flat may consider renting from the open market or staying with family or friends.

speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development )
text: If they have no housing options and family support, they may apply for public rental housing.

speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development )
text: Divorcees may also approach HDB if they require further assistance or advice on their housing options.
